headlines.title: Anthropic falls below IPO price as Nvidia gives back gains
headlines.summary: In this edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi sorts through "reality trading" as Nvidia slides nearly 7% after Monday's 31% surge and Anthropic falls below its $83 IPO price less than a week after the biggest offering in history. GCG Advisory Partners' Bill Gunderson makes the case that Nvidia is the cheapest growth stock in the market at nine times forward earnings and names Nvidia and Eli Lilly as his top picks for 2027. Brian breaks down Dell's blowout quarter and $132 billion AI backlog, and HPE CEO Antonio Neri joins to explain the company's raised outlook, why it refuses to finance neoclouds, and whether server margins have peaked. Brian closes by arguing the AI trade is reaching consumers' wallets, pointing to Best Buy's strongest comparable sales growth in five years.

headlines.title: Warren Buffett Finished Buying Coca-Cola in August 1994 and Never Bought Another Share. Under Greg Abel, Berkshire Now Collects $2.3 Million a Day From It
headlines.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's 400 million Coca-Cola shares, bought for $1,299 million between 1988 and 1994 and never added to since, now pay $848 million a year, about $2.3 million a day. Computed from Coca-Cola's split-adjusted dividend history, the checks since 1994 add up to about $13 billion, ten times the cost, and the next $212 million payment is due December 15.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola hires pharma vet for CFO
headlines.summary: The beverage giant is breaking from its typical practice of appointing insiders by naming pharma finance alum David Elkins as its incoming CFO, analysts noted.

description: The Coca-Cola Company, a beverage company, manufactures and sells various nonalcoholic beverages in the United States and internationally. The company provides Trademark Coca-Cola, sparkling soft drinks and flavors; water, sports, coffee, and tea; juice, value-added dairy, and plant-based beverages; and emerging beverages. It also offers beverage concentrates and syrups, as well as fountain syrups to fountain retailers comprising restaurants and convenience stores. The company sells its products under the Coca-Cola, Diet Coke/Coca-Cola Light, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, caffeine free Diet Coke, Cherry Coke, Fanta, Sprite, Simply, Fanta Orange, Fanta Zero Orange, Fanta Zero Sugar, Fanta Apple, Sprite Zero Sugar, Simply Orange, Simply Apple, Simply Grapefruit, Fresca, Schweppes, Thums Up, Aquarius, Ayataka, BODYARMOR, Ciel, Costa, Crystal, Dasani, Fuze Tea, Georgia, glacéau smartwater, glacéau vitaminwater, Gold Peak, I LOHAS, Powerade, Topo Chico, Core Power, Del Valle, fairlife, innocent, Maaza, Minute Maid, Minute Maid Pulpy, Santa Clara, and dogadan brands. It operates through a network of independent bottling partners, distributors, wholesalers, and retailers, as well as through bottling and distribution operators. The Coca-Cola Company was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
